question: Does adding the public Japanese core Nipponocirsium sample change the placement of the orientation transition inferred on the restricted six-taxon East-Asian scaffold?

source_observations.Cirsium_morii_phylogenetic_position: early-diverging member of subsect. Nipponocirsium in Chang et al. 2026

restricted_six_taxon_inference.reason: With Japanese core Nipponocirsium omitted, C. morii is the erect sister to the three nodding Taiwan tips, so minimum change is placed on the Taiwan-trio stem.

crossstudy_refined_inference.synthetic_topology: C. morii(U) sister to core Nipponocirsium, with Japanese core(D) sister to Taiwan core(D)
crossstudy_refined_inference.minimum_transition_placement: stem of core Nipponocirsium after the C. morii split and before the Japanese-Taiwan core split
crossstudy_refined_inference.uncertainty: The 0.79 and 0.74 Ma estimates come from separate dated analyses. Their marginal uncertainty intervals overlap and cannot be combined as a joint posterior branch interval.

environmental_consequence.Taiwan_0_79_0_47_paleoclimate_runs: retain as restricted-tree descendant-lineage sensitivities, not as the unique historical transition environment
environmental_consequence.primary_T3_status: not_evaluable until a joint chronology/paleolocation scenario can be defended from public data
environmental_consequence.biological_value: The taxon-sampling shift itself demonstrates why present geographic descendants cannot be assumed to identify the geographic setting of trait origin.

sources: Chang et al. 2026, BMC Plant Biology, DOI 10.1186/s12870-026-08097-6
Chang et al. 2025, Botanical Studies, DOI 10.1186/s40529-025-00454-2
Flora of Taiwan treatment of Cirsium morii
claim_boundary: The synthetic cross-study topology is a reconciliation sensitivity, not a single published dated tree.
Do not treat 0.74-0.79 Ma as a posterior event-age credible interval.
Do not assign Taiwan palaeoclimate to the transition after public Japanese core taxa are included.
Do not call independent origin, convergence, selection or adaptation from this refinement.
